# polaris_policy (Data Source)

Read an existing Polaris policy without granting access or persisting vended credentials.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "polaris_policy" "example" {
  catalog   = "warehouse"
  namespace = ["sales"]
  name      = "chosen"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) Containing catalog.
- `name` (String) Stable object name. Import existing names before applying.
- `namespace` (List of String) Namespace path components; dots remain literal.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) Policy content, validated by Polaris for its policy type.
- `description` (String) Policy description.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `metadata_json` (String, Sensitive) Current object metadata, excluding response credential-vending configuration.
- `type` (String) Server-supported maintenance policy type.
